passages.heading: Debt note
passages.text: 11. DEBT On September 16, 2024, the Company entered into a Credit Agreement, by and among the Company, as borrower, certain of the Company’s subsidiaries, as guarantors, the lenders and issuing banks party thereto, and with Citibank N.A., as administrative agent (the “Credit Agreement”), which provides for (i) a five-year revolving credit facility in an aggregate principal amount of up to $ 300.0 million, and (ii) an uncommitted increase option of up to an additional $ 300.0 million exercisable upon the satisfaction of certain customary conditions. The Credit Agreement provides for a $ 100.0 million sub-facility for the issuance of letters of credit, and certain existing letters of credit were deemed outstanding under this facility. The Credit Agreement will mature on September 16, 2029. Proceeds from the Credit Agreement may be used for general corporate purposes, including to finance working capital requirements. The Company’s obligations under the Credit Agreement are secured by substantially all the assets of the Company and its subsidiaries that are guarantors under the Credit Agreement. The Company may prepay, and in certain circumstances, would be required to prepay, loans under the Credit Agreement without payment of a premium. The Credit Agreement also contains customary representations and warranties, customary affirmative and negative covenants, financial covenants requiring the maintenance of a minimum interest coverage ratio and a maximum total net leverage ratio, as well as customary events of default, the occurrence of which could result in amounts borrowed under the Credit Agreement becoming due and payable and remaining commitments terminated prior to its scheduled September 16, 2029 termination date. Debt issuance costs incurred in connection with the Company’s Credit Agreement, which are recorded in Prepaid expenses and other current assets and Other non-current assets, are amortized over the five-year term and recognized as a component of interest expense in the consolidated statements of operations.

passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and related notes included in Item 8 of this Annual Report. In addition to historical financial information, the following discussion contains forward-looking statements that reflect our plans, estimates, beliefs, and expectations, and involve risks and uncertainties. Factors that could cause or contribute to these differences include those discussed below and elsewhere in this Annual Report, particularly in the section titled Item 1A. Risk Factors and the Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements. This section of this Annual Report generally discusses fiscal years 2025 and 2024 and year-to-year comparisons between those years. Discussions of fiscal year 2023 and year-to-year comparisons between fiscal years 2024 and 2023 that are not included in this Annual Report can be found in Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations in Item 7 of our Annual Report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 filed with the SEC on February 14, 2025. Overview Our two reportable segments are the Platform segment and the Devices segment. Platform revenue is generated from the sale of digital advertising (including direct and programmatic video advertising, ads integrated into our user 42 Table of Contents interface (“UI”), and related services) and streaming services distribution (including subscription and transaction revenue shares, the sale of Premium Subscriptions, the sale of owned and operated subscription services, and the sale of branded app buttons on remote controls). Devices revenue is generated from the sale of streaming players, Roku-made TVs, smart home products and services, audio products, and related accessories. We expect to continue to manage the average selling prices of Roku streaming devices in an effort to sell more devices, which we believe will increase our Streaming Households. We expect that this trade off from Devices gross profit or loss to grow Streaming Households should result in increased Platform revenue and Platform gross profit over time. Business Conditions and Macroeconomic Factors Our business is subject to risks related to the evolving macroeconomic environment, including the effects of increased volatility in financial markets, higher inflation and interest rates, potential economic slowdown or recession, geopolitical developments, changes in economic or government policies, including the unknown impact of tariffs, changing global regulations, and the overall uncertainty surrounding international trade relations. While we intend to remain vigilant in monitoring the impacts of these circumstances on our business and adapt accordingly, the effects of these macroeconomic factors on our business, results of operations, and financial condition remain largely uncertain. See Item 1A, Risk Factors, and the Note Regarding Forward Looking Statements elsewhere in this Annual Report for additional details. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Our business involves significant risks, some of which are described below. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all the other information in this Annual Report, including “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and the consolidated financial statements and the related notes. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, reputation, financial condition, results of operations, revenue, key performance metrics, and future prospects could be seriously harmed. In addition, you should consider the interrelationship and compounding effects of two or more risks occurring simultaneously. Unless otherwise indicated, references to our business being harmed in these risk factors will include harm to our business, reputation, financial condition, results of operations, revenue, key performance metrics, and future prospects. In that event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you could lose part or all of your investment. You should not interpret our disclosure of any of the following risks to imply that such risks have not already materialized. credit_strengths.text: Revenue has compounded steadily across the three-year trend, with the latest fiscal year showing the strongest absolute increase, while operating losses narrowed sharply toward breakeven. This trajectory suggests the Platform advertising and streaming distribution mix is scaling faster than the Devices drag, supporting a constructive view on future EBITDA generation.

Liquidity is a clear strength: cash balances and a current ratio well above the sector median provide a substantial buffer. Operating cash flow and free cash flow are both solidly positive, and capital expenditure is minimal, so internally generated funds comfortably cover near-term obligations without external refinancing.

key_risks.text: The debt note discloses a secured revolving credit facility maturing in the medium term, with financial covenants requiring minimum interest coverage and maximum total net leverage. Because the facility is secured by substantially all assets and carries an uncommitted increase option, covenant headroom and collateral encumbrance are material considerations if Platform growth stalls.

Risk factors highlight intense competition in streaming TV, dependence on advertising monetization, content partner renewals, and supply chain or tariff pressures. These are concrete earnings drivers: any advertising slowdown or loss of key content partners would pressure Platform revenue and delay the path to sustained operating profitability.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage is negative on a reported operating basis, far below the sector median, because operating income is marginally negative while interest expense is small but non-zero. However, cash generation is strong: operating cash flow and free cash flow are positive and capital expenditure is negligible, so cash-based debt service capacity is better than the coverage ratio implies.

The debt note indicates the revolver is largely undrawn, with no funded debt tagged on the balance sheet, so reported interest expense mainly reflects commitment and amortization costs. If the facility were drawn, cash interest would rise, but current cash and free cash flow provide ample capacity to absorb a moderate draw for working capital or general corporate purposes.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a improving credit profile: revenue growth, narrowing operating losses, positive free cash flow, and a large cash position. The absence of funded debt and the undrawn revolver mean leverage metrics are not meaningful, but the secured facility and covenants warrant monitoring. Share buybacks and acquisitions absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow, tempering deleveraging capacity.

Analyst judgement: the indicative financial risk profile is constrained by missing debt data, but the combination of cash, positive free cash flow, and a current ratio above the sector median supports an investment-grade-like liquidity profile. The key forward-looking risk is whether Platform advertising growth can offset competitive and content-cost pressures to sustain positive operating income.

credit_strengths.text: 收入於三年趨勢中穩步複合增長，最近一個財政年度錄得最強絕對增幅，同時經營虧損大幅收窄至接近收支平衡。此軌跡顯示平台廣告及串流分銷組合的擴張速度快於裝置業務的拖累，支持對未來 EBITDA 產生的建設性看法。
流動性為明顯優勢：現金結餘及流動比率遠高於行業中位數，提供充裕緩衝。經營現金流及自由現金流均穩健為正，且資本開支極少，故內部產生資金足以輕鬆覆蓋短期債務，無需外部再融資。

key_risks.text: 債務票據披露一項於中期到期的有抵押循環信貸融資，其財務契諾要求最低利息覆蓋率及最高總淨槓桿。由於該融資以絕大部分資產作抵押，並附帶非承諾增加選項，若平台增長停滯，契諾餘裕及抵押品產權負擔將成為重大考慮因素。
風險因素凸顯串流電視的激烈競爭、對廣告變現的依賴、內容合作夥伴續約，以及供應鏈或關稅壓力。此等均為具體盈利驅動因素：任何廣告放緩或失去主要內容合作夥伴，將對平台收入構成壓力，並延遲達致持續經營盈利的路徑。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 按報告經營基準計算，利息覆蓋率為負，遠低於行業中位數，因經營收入輕微為負，而利息開支雖小但非零。然而，現金產生強勁：經營現金流及自由現金流為正，且資本開支微不足道，故以現金為基礎的債務償付能力較覆蓋率所顯示為佳。
債務票據顯示循環信貸大致未提取，資產負債表上亦無標示已融資債務，故報告利息開支主要反映承諾費及攤銷成本。若該融資被提取，現金利息將上升，但當前現金及自由現金流提供充裕能力，以吸收為營運資金或一般企業用途而作出的適度提取。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現改善中的信用狀況：收入增長、經營虧損收窄、自由現金流為正，以及龐大現金頭寸。缺乏已融資債務及循環信貸未提取，意味槓桿指標不具意義，但有抵押融資及契諾值得監察。股份回購及收購吸收相當部分自由現金流，削弱去槓桿能力。
分析師判斷：指示性財務風險狀況受缺失債務數據所限制，但現金、正自由現金流及高於行業中位數的流動比率之組合，支持類投資級的流動性狀況。關鍵前瞻性風險在於平台廣告增長能否抵銷競爭及內容成本壓力，以維持正經營收入。
